'''Phindar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. It was controlled by a criminal organization, the [[Syndicat]], until [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], when it was overthrown by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The [[Phindian/Legends|Phindians]] then [[Democracy/Legends|elected]] a [[Governor/Legends|Governor]]. The planet was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by [[Phindar Station]], which was twice attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was here that, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress confronted Yoda, Jedi Knights Maks Leem and Jai Maruk, and their respective Padawans "Scout" ([[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]]) and [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] while they were en route to Vjun.

The planet was an early member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
